name: 13. OpenRouter Prompt Caching (cache_control)
description: Sends OpenAI-format chat requests through the OpenRouter provider with Anthropic-style cache_control breakpoints on content blocks and tools. OpenRouter forwards cache_control to Claude/Gemini (explicit caching) and harmlessly ignores it for implicit-caching models (OpenAI/DeepSeek) — these must NOT 400. Bifrost preserves cache_control only when the provider is OpenRouter (stripped for native OpenAI).
